design: Tall barrel-chested guard wearing an elongated black biomask with a swept-back crest, two small lateral sensor fins, narrow green glass eye slits, and deeply fluted lower jaw. Dreadlocks long and heavy behind mask. Heavy black leather apron-like battle skirt with bronze vertical ribs, open shoulder armoring showing grey speckled muscular arms, high angular gorget, multiple broad belt clasps. Right hand carries a folded two-pronged staff alongside thigh, left hand loosely open. Quiet unthreatening city guard stance.
